cohort: Women receiving an epidural for labor analgesia
finding: Women receiving epidurals for labor analgesia have an increased risk of intrapartum fever, potentially due to noninfectious inflammation, which can lead to increased antibiotic use, cesarean delivery, and adverse neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Women receiving epidurals for labor analgesia have an increased risk of intrapartum fever, which can lead to increased cesarean delivery.
